19	(* ----- M5.0 Definitions ----------------------------------------------------- *)
20	
21	(* Vertex i is internal (not an endpoint) iff it has window_size > 1. *)
22	Definition is_internal (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : bool :=
23	  (i < size w) && (1 < window_size i w).
24	
25	(* Apply a sequence of psi operators left-to-right. *)
26	Definition apply_psis (ops : seq nat) (w : seq nat) : seq nat :=
27	  foldl (fun w' i => psi i w') w ops.
28	
29	(* Characteristic monomial: the seq of descent bits, true = b, false = a. *)
30	Definition char_mono (w : seq nat) : seq bool :=
31	  [seq is_descent_seq w k | k <- iota 0 (size w).-1].
32	
33	(* The cd-alphabet for classifying internal vertices. *)
34	Inductive cde := C_letter | D_letter | E_letter.
35	
36	Definition classify_vertex_cde (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : cde :=
37	  if ~~ is_internal i w then E_letter
38	  else if has_left_child i w then D_letter
39	  else C_letter.
40	
41	(* Φ'_w: the full classification string (one letter per vertex). *)
42	Definition phi'_w (w : seq nat) : seq cde :=
43	  [seq classify_vertex_cde i w | i <- iota 0 (size w)].
44	
45	(* Φ_w: delete endpoints (set e = 1, the empty word). *)
46	Definition phi_w (w : seq nat) : seq cde :=
47	  [seq x <- phi'_w w | match x with E_letter => false | _ => true end].
48	
49	(* The list of internal vertex positions, sorted. *)
50	Definition internal_vertices (w : seq nat) : seq nat :=
51	  [seq i <- iota 0 (size w) | is_internal i w].
52	
53	(* Expand a cd-word into the multiset of seq bool words.
54	   c = a + b expands to {[false], [true]}.
55	   d = ab + ba expands to {[false;true], [true;false]}. *)
56	Fixpoint expand_cde (letters : seq cde) : seq (seq bool) :=
57	  match letters with
58	  | [::] => [:: [::]]
59	  | C_letter :: rest =>
60	      let tails := expand_cde rest in
61	      [seq false :: t | t <- tails] ++ [seq true :: t | t <- tails]
62	  | D_letter :: rest =>
63	      let tails := expand_cde rest in
64	      [seq false :: true :: t | t <- tails] ++ [seq true :: false :: t | t <- tails]
65	  | E_letter :: rest => expand_cde rest
66	  end.

69	Definition powerset_internal (w : seq nat) : seq (seq nat) :=
70	  let ivs := internal_vertices w in

74	Fixpoint leq_seqb (s1 s2 : seq bool) : bool :=

76	  | [::], _ => true
77	  | _ :: _, [::] => false
78	  | b1 :: s1', b2 :: s2' =>
